label: The completeness of physics: every PHYSICAL_2 effect is fully determined by law by prior PHYSICAL_2…
paraphrase: The completeness of physics: every physical effect is fully determined by law by prior physical occurrences. 'Physical' is Papineau's sense (specifiable without the special, e.g. mental, vocabulary at issue); the relata are occurrences, not beings. It says nothing about nonphysical things and is not itself physicalism.
